Design a plan to fix all animation/layout issues in this React SaaS app to make page transitions feel instant, smooth, and professional. The user says the current animations feel immature and laggy — content slides/fades in on every page switch, and there are layout shifts (width changes, content jumping). ## Issues Found ### Issue 1: FadeIn + StaggerList animations replay on EVERY page navigation Every page wraps content in `` (250ms fade+slide) and `` (80ms stagger per child). When navigating between Settings → Billing → Profile → Team etc., content fades up and staggers in EVERY TIME. This feels laggy — in a mature SaaS, navigating between pages should show content instantly. **Pages affected:** Settings, Billing, Profile, Team, Tasks, Activity, CareerSettings (7 pages + LandingPage) **Current pattern in every page:** ```tsx

Page Title

 ... ...
``` **FadeIn component** (`src/components/ui/fade-in.tsx`): - Uses framer-motion `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}` → `animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}` - Duration: 250ms, ease: "easeOut" - Replays EVERY time component mounts (every navigation) **StaggerList component** (`src/components/ui/stagger-list.tsx`): - Wraps each child in a motion.div with staggered fade+slide - stagger: 80ms between children - Duration: 250ms each ### Issue 2: Inconsistent max-widths cause horizontal content jumps When navigating between pages, the content area width visibly shifts: - Settings, Billing, Profile, Team, Tasks, Activity, CareerSettings → `max-w-2xl` (672px) - Index (dashboard/my-jobs) → `max-w-5xl` (1024px) - Changelog → `max-w-[700px]` - RequestFeature, BookDemo → `max-w-4xl` (896px) ### Issue 3: Index.tsx has its own SidebarProvider Index.tsx creates its own `` + `` + `` (line 239), while every other authenticated page uses `` which creates a separate SidebarProvider. When navigating between Index and any other page, the sidebar completely re-mounts, causing a visible flash/shift. ## Proposed Solution ### Fix 1: Replace FadeIn + StaggerList with instant rendering on authenticated pages Remove FadeIn and StaggerList from all 7 authenticated pages (Settings, Billing, Profile, Team, Tasks, Activity, CareerSettings). Content should render instantly — no fade, no stagger. This is what Vercel, Linear, Stripe dashboards do. KEEP FadeIn/StaggerList only on LandingPage (marketing page where entry animations add value). For each page, replace: ```tsx

Title

 ... ``` With: ```tsx

Title

...
``` ### Fix 2: Standardize max-widths The Changelog page should use `max-w-2xl` to match other sidebar pages. Sidebar pages that show dense content (like Index dashboard) keep `max-w-5xl` — that's expected to be wider. ### Fix 3: Do NOT restructure Index's SidebarProvider right now Index.tsx has a fundamentally different layout (it controls the sidebar state like showing Dashboard vs My Jobs). Restructuring this is a large refactor with high risk. The current approach already works — the flash is caused by the FadeIn animations, not the sidebar itself. Fixing the animations (Fix 1) will eliminate most of the perceived lag. ## Files to Modify 1. `src/pages/Settings.tsx` — remove FadeIn/StaggerList imports and usage 2. `src/pages/Billing.tsx` — same 3. `src/pages/Profile.tsx` — same 4. `src/pages/Team.tsx` — same 5. `src/pages/Tasks.tsx` — same 6. `src/pages/Activity.tsx` — same 7. `src/pages/CareerSettings.tsx` — same 8. `src/pages/Changelog.tsx` — change max-w-[700px] to max-w-2xl 9. `src/components/LandingPage.tsx` — KEEP animations (marketing page) Please provide the detailed implementation plan.
